title: US$9.2 Billion in Annual Sales—Why Does J&J Still Want to Separate Orthopaedics?
author: 藥時事 Drugnews
summary: Why might an orthopaedics business with US$9.2 billion in annual sales lose priority for J&J’s next investment? Growth differences, the value flows in a spin-off versus a sale, and the costs of implants and surgical support explain the economic questions behind the proposed DePuy Synthes separation.
cover_image_alt: The strategic priorities of J&J and a proposed independent DePuy Synthes. The separation is not completed, and growth and margin improvements remain company expectations.
